description: Test suite for X25519 elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman function, including vector tests, small order tests, iterative tests, and Wycheproof test vector validation.

methods.name: TestVector
methods.description: Tests X25519 with known test vectors from RFC 7748.

methods.name: SmallOrder
methods.description: Tests X25519 with a small order point to ensure proper rejection.

methods.name: Iterated
methods.description: Performs repeated X25519 computations to verify consistency.

methods.name: DISABLED_IteratedLarge
methods.description: Performs a large number of iterations for stress testing, currently disabled.

methods.name: Wycheproof
methods.description: Validates X25519 implementation against Wycheproof test vectors.
